discovery.title: Access to bilingual education lags behind in Andalusia's rural areas, study reveals
discovery.summary: Over the past two decades, bilingual education programs have significantly expanded within the Spanish education system, with the aim of improving foreign language learning—primarily English—while making it more accessible for all. Although more and more schools are offering bilingual education, they are unevenly distributed across the country, generating inequalities among students.
